edit.statement: 'Shares a birthday with' (was born on the same day of the year as) is transitive.
edit.subject: shares_birthday_with
edit.scope: Same calendar day of birth, regardless of year.

direct.prompt: Is the relation 'shares a birthday with' transitive?

cross_lingual.prompt: 猫王埃尔维斯·普雷斯利与斯蒂芬·霍金同一天生日，斯蒂芬·霍金与大卫·鲍伊同一天生日。能否由此推出埃尔维斯·普雷斯利与大卫·鲍伊同一天生日？
Elvis Presley cumple años el mismo día que Stephen Hawking, y Stephen Hawking cumple años el mismo día que David Bowie. ¿Se deduce que Elvis Presley cumple años el mismo día que David Bowie?

derived.prompt: Elvis Presley shares a birthday with Stephen Hawking, and Stephen Hawking shares a birthday with David Bowie. Does it follow that Elvis Presley shares a birthday with David Bowie?
bridge: Elvis Presley shares a birthday with Stephen Hawking, and Stephen Hawking shares a birthday with David Bowie.

derived.prompt: Abraham Lincoln shares a birthday with Charles Darwin, and Charles Darwin shares a birthday with Judy Blume. Does it follow that Abraham Lincoln shares a birthday with Judy Blume?
bridge: Abraham Lincoln shares a birthday with Charles Darwin, and Charles Darwin shares a birthday with Judy Blume.

notes: Real: true by definition (same day of the year is an equivalence relation), but the property of this relation is rarely stated. Instance facts are true: Presley (1935), Hawking (1942) and Bowie (1947) were all born on 8 January; Lincoln and Darwin on 12 February 1809, Judy Blume on 12 February 1938. Locality reference is the logical answer; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer. Instance facts are stated in the prompt.
